defs.def: a period or state that sth/sb passes through while developing or making progress （发展或进展的）时期，阶段，状态

ex.s: In this book I examine three crucial stages in the history of mean sea level.
ex.t: 在本书中，我考察了平均海平面历史上的三个关键阶段。

ex.s: These stages mirror the development of human conceptions of the sea.
ex.t: 这些阶段反映了人类对海洋认知的发展。

ex.s: Psychologist Robert Turner wrote about this in his book, The Life Cycle, mentioning a stage when kids learn self-direction and mastery. ____35____
ex.t: 我用一块布堵住那个洞，然后把它带到外面，随手关好了门。

ex.s: When this stage is denied it creates a sense of insecurity.
ex.t: 他们承诺会修理窗户。

ex.s: Turner, a 10th-grader at School for Creative and Performing Arts, is a familiar presence on Cincinnati’s stages.
ex.t: 特纳是一名十年级学生，就读于创意与表演艺术学院，是辛辛那提舞台上的熟面孔。

ex.s: They are experienced on stage.
ex.t: 他们舞台经验丰富。

ex.s: After two months we were all prepared and ready to go on stage.
ex.t: 两个月后，我们都准备好了，可以登台了。

ex.s: As Kristian Hammond, professor of electrical engineering and computer science at Northwestern University, put it: “There’s never a stage at which the system knows what it’s talking about.”
ex.t: 正如西北大学电气工程和计算机科学教授克里斯蒂安·哈蒙德所说："系统从来没有一个阶段知道自己谈论的是什么。"

ex.s: It is hard to name a comedy star who hasn’t been on the stage here.
ex.t: 很难说出哪位喜剧明星没有在这个舞台上演出过。

ex.s: Yet properly understood, the age of electricity is merely the second stage in the age of steam, which began a century earlier.
ex.t: 然而正确理解的话，电力时代仅仅是蒸汽时代的第二阶段，蒸汽时代开始于一个世纪前。

ex.s: Lots of other technologies have gone through stages of excitement.
ex.t: 许多其他技术都经历过兴奋阶段。

ex.s: In his spare time though he goes on stage beside pianist Maria Raspopova — not as a musician but as her page turner.
ex.t: 但在业余时间，他登上舞台站在钢琴家玛丽亚·拉斯波波娃身边——不是作为音乐家，而是作为她的翻谱员。

ex.s: He said he became just as nervous as those playing instruments on stage.
ex.t: 他说他变得和台上演奏乐器的人一样紧张。

ex.s: Most page turners are piano students or up-and-coming concert pianists, although Ms Raspopova has once asked her husband to help her out on stage.
ex.t: 大多数翻谱员是钢琴学生或崭露头角的音乐会钢琴家，尽管拉斯波波娃女士曾经让她丈夫在台上帮忙。

ex.s: 25.Which of the following best describes Titterton’s job on stage?
ex.t: 25.以下哪项最能描述蒂特顿在台上的工作？

ex.s: During the training stage, each dog was shown only the upper half or the lower half of the person’s face.
ex.t: 研究人员发现狗能够通过用鼻子触摸图片来选择生气或开心的脸而且频率高于随机概率。

ex.s: The study showed the animals had figured out how to apply what they learned about human faces during training to new faces in the testing stage.
ex.t: "相反我们的结果表明成功的狗意识到微笑的嘴意味着和微笑的眼睛相同的事情同样的规则适用于生气的嘴意味着和生气的眼睛相同的事情。"

ex.s: Pictures used in the two stages were different
ex.t: 最后一段主要讲了什么？

ex.s: He is a professional stage actor.
ex.t: 他是一名专业舞台演员。

ex.s: ideal sound effects on the theater stage
ex.t: 餐厅菜单的创意设计

ex.t: 10.（1分）大多数学院现在为一年级学生开设一门专门设计的课程来帮助他们在学业和个人方面取得成功．（  ）

ex.s: While famous foreign architects are invited to lead the designs of landmark buildings in China such as the new CCTV tower and the National Center for the Performing Arts, many excellent Chinese architects are making great efforts to take the center stage.
ex.t: 不同形状的混合。

ex.s: While high school does not generally encourage students to explore new aspects of life, college sets the stage for that exploration.
ex.t: 虽然高中通常不鼓励学生探索生活的新方面，但大学为这种探索搭建了舞台。

defs.def: a separate part that a process, etc. is divided into 段；步；步骤
a raised area, usually in a theatre, etc. where actors, dancers, etc. perform （多指剧场中的）舞台

ex.s: That’s the local stage writing team that creates many of the Children’s Theatre of Cincinnati’s original musicals, along with the holiday family musicals at Ensemble Theatre.
ex.t: 这就是本地编剧团队，他们创作了辛辛那提儿童剧院的多部原创音乐剧，以及 Ensemble Theatre 的节日家庭音乐剧。

defs.def: the theatre and the world of acting as a form of entertainment 戏剧；戏剧表演；戏剧界
an area of activity where important things happen, especially in politics （政治等活动的）领域；（政治）舞台

ex.s: A spotlight lights up only one section of a stage; similarly,"spotsound" creates a circle of sound in on targeted area.
ex.t: 只需转动机器或将它对准目标，你的安宁和宁静就回来了。

defs.def: to organize and present a play or an event for people to see 上演；举办；举行

ex.s: To get the most out of reading these plays, try to picture the play on stage, with you, the reader, in the audience.
ex.t: 要充分阅读这些剧本，试着想象舞台上的演出场景，你——读者——坐在观众席上。

defs.def: to organize and take part in action that needs careful planning, especially as a public protest 组织；筹划

ex.s: To celebrate the 2017 festival, over 1,000 Ghanaian junior high school students got up on stage to perform Chinese songs and dances.
ex.t: 为庆祝2017年节庆活动，超过一千名加纳初中学生登台表演了中国歌舞。

ex.s: Then, seeing the main characters come on stage, I was surprised!
ex.t: 然后，看到主角们登上舞台，我惊呆了！

ex.s: And the stage was really simple: a decorated whip represented a horse, and a screen with Chinese characters, a study.
ex.t: 舞台也真的很简单：一根装饰过的鞭子代表马，一块写有汉字的屏风代表书房。

ex.s: Using such techniques, the opera had transformed a small stage into the whole universe.
ex.t: 运用这些手法，戏曲把一个小小的舞台变成了整个宇宙。

ex.s: In sentence (b), who saw the main characters come on stage?
ex.t: 在句子(b)中，谁看到主角们登上舞台？

defs.def: to make sth happen 使发生；使出现
